# ADHD-DATABASEN

**ADHD-DATABASEN** is the central national quality database in Denmark that monitors the quality of assessment and treatment for patients with ADHD [^src1]. Initially focused on children and adolescents in child and adolescent psychiatry, it serves as the foundational infrastructure for the national annual reports on ADHD care quality [^src1]. The database's analyses are prepared by the [[rkkp|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP) and later the [[sundhedsvaesnets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]], and the reports are audited by the [[styregruppen|Styregruppen]] (steering committee) [^src1], [^src10]. The database is governed and chaired by [[shelagh-powell|Shelagh Powell]] and [[simon-hjerrild|Simon Hjerrild]] [^src1], [^src10]. It collaborates closely with the [[danske-multidisciplinaere-psykiatrigrupper-dmpger|Danske Multidisciplinære Psykiatrigrupper (DMPGer)]] and aligns with political initiatives like the [[10-aars-planen|10 års planen]] to improve psychiatric care [^src2]. The database's standards and clinical indicators are also heavily influenced by national guidelines such as the [[dmpg-retningslinje|DMPG-retningslinjen: Udredning af ADHD hos børn og unge i hospitalsregi og speciallægepraksis]] [^src10].

The database tracks two primary cohorts: the [[adhd-udredningspopulation|ADHD-udredningspopulation]] (assessment population) and the [[adhd-behandlingspopulation|ADHD-behandlingspopulation]] (treatment population) [^src8]. To streamline clinical workflows and avoid double registration, the database pulls data directly from the [[lpr|LPR]] (Landspatientregisteret) [^src19]. It also relies on specific procedural codes, such as the [[agx01b|AGX01B]] marker, to identify and exclude invalidated assessments from the statistics [^src20]. All five Danish regions—[[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]]—contribute data to the database and participate in annual consultation hearings [^src8], [^src21]. Furthermore, specific departments like [[bispebjerg-bup-ambulatorium|Bispebjerg: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]], [[bornholm-bup-ambulatorium|Bornholm: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]], [[glostrup-bup-ambulatorium|Glostrup: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]], [[hillerod-psykiatrisk-ambulatorium-boern-og-unge|Hillerød: Psykiatrisk ambulatorium, børn og unge]], [[bua-smaborn-klinik|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Småbørn]], and [[bua-psykiatrisk-klinik-for-udredning|BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Udredning]] report their metrics directly to the database [^src15].

ADHD-DATABASEN manages a comprehensive suite of quality indicators (Indikator 1 through 11) that measure various aspects of clinical care [^src11]. These include somatic assessments ([[indikator-1|Indikator 1]]), clinical environmental observations for 0-5 year olds ([[indikator-2a|Indikator 2a]]), and structured diagnostic interviews or observations for 6-17 year olds ([[indikator-2b|Indikator 2b]]) [^src11]. Other process indicators track diagnostic conferences ([[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]), coordinating network meetings ([[indikator-4|Indikator 4]]), psychoeducation ([[indikator-5|Indikator 5]]), and pharmacological treatment ([[indikator-6|Indikator 6]]) [^src11]. The database also monitors long-term educational outcomes, specifically the rate of youth passing the primary school leaving exam ([[indikator-7a|Indikator 7a]] and [[indikator-7b|Indikator 7b]]) [^src11]. 

The 2024/2025 annual report marked a historic expansion for the database, incorporating data from the adult population and [[privathospitaler|Privathospitaler]] for the first time [^src10]. This expansion introduced new indicators for adults, including psychotherapy ([[indikator-9|Indikator 9]]), social support assessments ([[indikator-10|Indikator 10]]), and adult pharmacological treatment ([[indikator-11|Indikator 11]]) [^src17], [^src18], [^src19]. Despite these advancements, the database's reports highlight severe systemic challenges in Danish psychiatry. Most process indicators fail to meet the national 90% standard, revealing widespread issues with registration practices, capacity constraints, and fragmented care pathways [^src4], [^src10]. For example, regions like [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] have struggled with capacity issues that force them to outsource assessments to private actors, which negatively impacts data completeness and indicator fulfillment [^src9], [^src13]. Similarly, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] has shown significant regional variations in the use of the AGX01B marker to rule out ADHD suspicions [^src20]. Ultimately, the database serves as a critical mirror to the structural and clinical realities of ADHD care in Denmark, driving ongoing revisions to how quality is defined and measured [^src14].

## Timeline
- 2023-04-01: Start af måleperiode for ADHD-databasens årsrapport 2023 (adhd-databasen)
- 2024-03-31: Afslutning af måleperiode for ADHD-databasens årsrapport 2023 (adhd-databasen)
- 2025-01-22: Udgivelse af ADHD-databasens årsrapport 2023 (adhd-databasen)
- 01.04.2023: Start af opgørelsesperioden for de aktuelle årsrapporterede indikatorresultater (adhd-databasen)
- 31.03.2024: Slut på opgørelsesperioden for de aktuelle årsrapporterede indikatorresultater (adhd-databasen)
- 25.05.2021: Godkendelsesdato for Indikator 4–6, hvorfra data for disse indikatorer er registreret (adhd-databasen)
- 01.04.2023 - 31.03.2024: Opgørelsesperioden for indikator 2a i ADHD-DATABASEN (adhd-databasen)
- 01.04.2023: Start af opgørelsesperioden for indikator 2b (adhd-databasen, indicator-2b)
- 31.03.2024: Slut på opgørelsesperioden for indikator 2b (adhd-databasen, indicator-2b)
- 25. maj 2021: Behandlingspopulationen blev sat i drift i ADHD-databasen (adhd-behandlingspopulation, adhd-databasen)
- 1. april 2023: Start af opgørelsesperioden for årsrapporten 2023/24 (adhd-databasen)
- 31. marts 2024: Afslutning af opgørelsesperioden for årsrapporten 2023/24 (adhd-databasen)
- 15. september 2024: Rådata til årsrapporten blev opdateret (adhd-databasen)
- 2024-04-01: Start af måleperiode for ADHD-databasens årsrapport 2024 (adhd-databasen)
- 2025-03-31: Afslutning af måleperiode for ADHD-databasens årsrapport 2024 (adhd-databasen)
- 2026-02-16: Offentliggørelse af ADHD-databasens årsrapport 2024 (adhd-databasen)
- 01.04.2024: Start af dataindsamlingsperiode for den aktuelle årsrapport (adhd-databasen)
- 31.03.2025: Afslutning af dataindsamlingsperiode for den aktuelle årsrapport (adhd-databasen)
- 01.04.2024 - 31.03.2025: Aktuel årsrapportperiode for ADHD-DATABASEN, hvori alle indikatorværdier i tabellerne er beregnet. (adhd-databasen)
- 2025-08-15: Seneste dato for indrapportering af data til databasen (adhd-databasen)
- 2024: ADHD-databasen blev udvidet til også at omfatte voksne i behandlingspopulationen, hvilket førte til første beregning af Indikator 11. (adhd-databasen, indikator-11)
- 25. maj 2021: ADHD-databasen blev udvidet med en ADHD-behandlingspopulation for børn/unge. (adhd-databasen)
- 01.04.2024: Start af opgørelsesperioden for ADHD-databasens udrednings- og behandlingsdata (adhd-databasen)
- 31.03.2025: Slut på opgørelsesperioden for ADHD-databasens udrednings- og behandlingsdata (adhd-databasen)
- 2024-12-04: Årsrapporten for ADHD-databasen blev sendt i høring til regioner og afdelinger (adhd-databasen)
- 2025-01-17: Høringsperioden for årsrapporten for ADHD-databasen blev afsluttet (adhd-databasen)
